summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, disclosing a routine PDMR (person discharging managerial responsibilities) share transaction. Chief Financial Officer Sinead Gorman disposed of 30,000 ordinary shares at £33.686565 per share on July 31, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange, totaling approximately £1,010,597. This is a standard insider transaction notification under UK/EU market abuse regulations, not a special situation. No corporate action, strategic review, or deal is involved. The filing merely complies with disclosure obligations. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
